ValidationRule.description: End time always should be greater than Start time
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Start_Date__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Start_Time__c)), NOT(ISBLANK( End_Date__c )), NOT(ISBLANK(End_Time__c)), (DATETIMEVALUE(TEXT(Start_Date__c) & " " & TEXT(Start_Time__c)) >= DATETIMEVALUE(TEXT(End_Date__c ) & " " & TEXT(End_Time__c))) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: End time always should be greater than Start time
